repair2_queue.title: Pixel-level proof harness and root-cause trace
repair2_queue.notes: PixelProofHarnessTest verifies LUT intensity 0 vs 1, parameter changes, disable/enable, reorder, and view modes; offline & zero-stubs CI checks pass.

repair2_queue.title: Frame import and reactive UI
repair2_queue.notes: Reactive StateFlow project state, 4-source frame import (Gallery, Video, Camera, Files) with EXIF rotation and project-local copy, plus CropEditorDialog.

repair2_queue.notes: Foreground service runs LutSolver on pair images, saves 33x33x33 .cube LUT, and ColorMath.parseCube33 loads it in TuneStage.

tasks.title: Verification harness (before fixing, so the fixes can be proven)
tasks.notes: Verification harness complete: added zero-stubs CI check and offline check in cc-studio-tests.yml, added CoreTestSuite and AppTestSuite, and SyntheticGenerator for deterministic demo test data.

tasks.title: Delete projects
tasks.notes: Implemented project delete with ConfirmDeleteDialog, recursive folder deletion in ProjectRepository, and Delete All Projects in Settings.

tasks.title: Add frames to pairs
tasks.notes: Implemented SourceStage with 4 frame sources (Gallery, Video, Camera, Files), two-step base/target picking, on-selection file copying, swap, crop editor, and fit gating.

tasks.title: Permissions
tasks.notes: Implemented just-in-time permissions with PermissionsHelper, explanation dialogs, fallbacks, and complete Permissions status table in Settings.

tasks.title: Add effects and the stack editor
tasks.notes: Implemented EffectRepository loading all 17 in-scope effects, AddEffectPickerSheet with search and 4 categories, stack reordering, duplicate, delete, all parameter control types, and undo/redo.

tasks.title: View modes and the viewer
tasks.notes: Implemented 8 active view modes (Result with press-and-hold Before, Wipe with flip, Side by side, Top/bottom, Vs Target, Difference + gain, Channels, Scopes), pan/zoom viewer, and frame strip.

tasks.title: Fit stage and Export stage, end to end
tasks.notes: Implemented FitStage with foreground service, determinate progress, metrics, and ExportStage with MediaStore downloads, collision handling, .cube and Hald Level 8 generation.

tasks.title: Release and proof (last)
tasks.notes: Release cc-studio-v2 successfully created and verified on GitHub Releases with signed APK and MOTIONSALT.kfpack asset.
